production_model: Own wool mills in Oregon and Washington
notes: Homepage: 'Free Shipping On All Orders Over $150'; 'FROM OUR HANDS TO YOURS'; site title 'World-Class Wool Clothing, Blankets & Decor'; store locator at /stores/ (https://www.pendleton-usa.com/).

Returns: 60 days from purchase or shipment, clean and unworn; mail-in label $9.25 deducted; free at Pendleton retail stores (https://www.pendleton-usa.com/help-center/customer-service/returns/returns.html).

Wikipedia: founded 1909 in Pendleton, Oregon; HQ Portland; weaving mill in Washougal, Washington since 1912; privately held, Bishop family; retail stores across the US (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pendleton_Woolen_Mills).

Board Shirt: $198, 100% pure virgin wool, 'Rugged, midweight fabric' that is water, odor and stain resistant; wool from Umatilla County, Oregon; 'Fabric woven in our American mills'; 'Assembled in El Salvador of USA made fabric' (item 50050; item 50050S says 'Imported of USA fabric'); square bottom, two flap chest pockets; Regular XS–3X (4X, 5X in dropdown), Tall M–3X ('Tall fits men 6' and up'), Big 4X–5X; care: machine wash cold gentle, no bleach, line dry, steam press with warm iron (https://www.pendleton-usa.com/product/mens-board-shirt/50050_32689.html).

Shipping: free on orders of $150 or more, $9.95 under; 'No, we currently ship only within the United States and Puerto Rico' (https://www.pendleton-usa.com/help-center/customer-service/shipping-information/shipping-info.html).
